name: Silent Hallcreeper

labels: ~ becomes a copy of another target creature you control.

abilities.text: Whenever ~ deals combat damage to a player, choose one that hasn't been chosen —

notes: The third mode's "another target creature you control" is a `choose-objects` pick plus `become-copy` on `that`: `legal.ts:nestedLists` does not descend into a family op's `modes`, so an effect inside `choose-modes` is never offered a target at cast time (docs/vocabulary/piles-choices.md 5). The choice is made as the ability resolves and skips the targeting legality checks (shroud / hexproof / protection); everything else is the printed behaviour.

issues: • This creature becomes a copy of another target creature you control. — expected a real target chosen when the trigger goes on the stack (shroud/protection checked, and the mode is not choosable with no legal target) — scripted choose-objects {filter:{types:[Creature],other:true}, who:you} + become-copy target:that, duration:permanent — chosen at resolution with no targeting legality check; the mode can still be picked with no other creature, resolving as nothing while burning the 'hasn't been chosen' slot — CR 115.1, 601.2c, 700.2c

choose one that hasn't been chosen — — expected a permanent per-object record — scripted notChosen:'ever' -> src.ext.pcModesEver, cleared only when the permanent leaves the battlefield (correct, CR 400.7). Verified in piles-choices.ts:294/499 — CR 700.2a
This creature can't be blocked. — expected static evasion — scripted keywords:['unblockable'] + covers by 'keywords'; characteristics.ts:557 honours it — CR 509.1a
